test_title: PYST 01: SSC Stenographer 2025: English Language & Comprehension (Held On: 06 Aug, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: english
question: Find the correctly structured sentence.

options.text: The authorities had taken the emergency steps before the storm hit
The storm was faced with emergency steps.
The emergency steps were taken before the storm hit.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence in **Option 1** is correctly structured and conveys the intended meaning accurately.
 
• It correctly states that the authorities had already taken emergency steps **before the storm hit**, which aligns with proper grammatical structure.
 
• Options 2, 3, and 4 either lack clarity, omit necessary details, or are structured incorrectly.
 
• Option 1 maintains the proper tense and logical sequence of actions.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"The authorities had taken the emergency steps before the storm hit."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2:** "The storm was faced with emergency steps." – This sentence lacks clarity and does not accurately describe the sequence of events.
 
• **Option 3:** "The authorities took emergency steps." – This sentence does not specify the timing of the actions relative to the storm.
 
• **Option 4:** "The emergency steps were taken before the storm hit." – While grammatically correct, it is less precise and lacks the subject performing the action (i.e., the authorities).
